# ShareFacts

Namespace `Nfty.Core.Publish.Community` in assembly `Nfty.Core`.

```csharp
public sealed record ShareFacts
```

What [`ShareCheck.CheckAsync()`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.ShareCheck.md#m-checkasync-system-string-system-threading-cancellationtoken) learned about a packed Set.

## Constructors

### ShareFacts(IReadOnlyList&lt;string&gt;, int, int, int, bool, bool, string?, string, string, string) { #m-ctor-system-collections-generic-ireadonlylist-system-s-8eafdf }

```csharp
public ShareFacts(IReadOnlyList<string> Problems, int Assets, int Width, int Height, bool Models, bool IncludesCookBook, string? CookbookSha256, string Collection, string Fingerprint, string FileSha256);
```

**Parameters**

- `Problems` (`IReadOnlyList<string>`) - What keeps the Set out of the gallery, in [`ShareRules`](Nfty.Core.Publish.Community.ShareRules.md)' words; empty when it may be shared. When not empty every other member is a default.
- `Assets` (`int`) - How many assets the Set holds.
- `Width` (`int`) - Canvas width in pixels.
- `Height` (`int`) - Canvas height in pixels.
- `Models` (`bool`) - Whether the Set carries 3D models.
- `IncludesCookBook` (`bool`) - Whether the Set's own CookBook rides inside it.
- `CookbookSha256` (`string?`) - The hash of the CookBook that made the Set, as `set.json` records it, or null.
- `Collection` (`string`) - The collection's name.
- `Fingerprint` (`string`) - Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the assets' DNA in number order: the same for the same assets whatever else was packed with them, different once the Set is extended.
- `FileSha256` (`string`) - Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the `.set` file itself, which is what a download is checked against.
